## Project: SwarmKey Protocol

Static website (vanilla HTML/CSS/JS) explaining the SwarmKey decentralized BYOK protocol. Deployed to GitHub Pages.

- No build step. No npm dependencies. Open `index.html` directly or use a static server.
- All styles in `assets/styles.css`. All JS in `assets/app.js`.
- Dark mode is default. Toggle via the nav button.
- Interactive elements: walkthrough (5 steps), routing demo (5 categories), policy manifest viewer.
